facts.fact: A law journal article by Bitone Viage says Mozambique has no specific legal provisions on AI-enabled digital crime such as deepfakes, algorithmic manipulation of data and automated attacks, a significant normative void.

MOZ.note: Document states nothing on government use of AI.
Document states nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
Document states nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: A law journal article by Bitone Viage lists the Lei das Transações Eletrónicas among the relevant legal instruments existing in Mozambique.
